Preserve newer native 599f008c257d CHECK_CONTAMINANT state/void callback/clean event and 1a4a2df07c1f extra SNK_DEBOUNCED transition. No historical getter or old state algorithm is resurrected; this is replacement evidence, not missing-consumer inference.

Full original patch or unique remerge diff examined. Getter/updater declarations and implementation are absent from final ACK and port; native capabilities handling remains. Do not resurrect an API final ACK removed.

Native FRS capability fields and enable callback survive; historical debouncing/int callback was explicitly removed and replaced by native CHECK_CONTAMINANT implementation. Preserve the complete current native state machine and callback types, with no binary KMI obligation.

Full original patch or unique remerge diff examined. scope: These 21 candidates are all retired, replaced or represented by the native LTS implementation. TCPM is enabled by SDK configuration; no claim of necessity based merely on disabled configuration or absent consumer. Later post-LTS PD additions and the separate FUSE part of b61b6f74f905 remain separate candidates.
validation: Source/history inspection and exact whole-file comparisons only; no Type-C controller or electrical/protocol runtime validation.
